cases.label: RET-COPY

cases.label: NO-CONST-RETURN
cases.expected: no RETURN holds a constant in any slot >= 1 anywhere (the GAP-B defect form RETURN const never appears)

cases.label: NON-RETURN

cases.label: MULTI-RET

cases.expected: one COPY each; the two COPY input-0 constants are distinct varnodes (opSetInput const dedup)

cases.label: NEG-CTL
cases.expected: untouched: keeps reading X, no COPY in b4

cases.label: COUNT

cases.label: RULEPROP
